data: GSSR, delay correction based on 0.5 sec bauds and 127 length code. Range correction to s234  is  -4  usec.
Correction of -5.5 usec to soln 233 from 1/2 usec imaging.  Placed the COM at the TE of the echo which is 10 rows deep.
Correction of -7 usec to solution 232 from 1 and 1/2 usec ranging. Placed COM at the TE of the 1/2 usec echo, which is 5 rows deep.
11 us correction to s230 based on 1 us ranging. Assumed echo to be at brightest pixel.
120 us correction to s229 based on 10 us ranging. Echo was unresolved.
